title: Orbit Pop
summary: A fast orbit pop challenge of moving targets and chained clicks.
instructions: Track the moving targets with your cursor and click to chain pops.

overlay.startCopy: A combo-driven orbital target game. Keep the chain alive and clear every ring before the pattern resets.

help.title: How To Start
steps: Press Start Orbit in the center overlay.
Move the cursor over the orbiting targets.
Click targets to keep the combo chain alive.
Missed clicks reset the chain, so recover quickly.
tips: Clear the nearest ring first to build momentum.
Keep your cursor close to the next target.

onboarding.title: Orbit Setup
startSteps: Open Help to review cursor timing.
Press Start Orbit to begin the ring chain.
Click the first available target and keep the combo alive.
onboarding.firstGoal: Build your first combo chain and clear the orbit ring.
